title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode3 The Most Heart-Pounding Song

rows.Line: Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That girl today was so cool. People who are working hard to achieve their dreams really do have a glow to them.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never heard that song she was singing before. I wonder if I could find a video or something online.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think the chorus was something like this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I guess that's not really enough to go on.
I should probably get started on my homework, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe I'll try searching just a bit longer.
<I found you.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My phone just!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A Miku...hologram?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hello there, Kohane. I'm the Miku from your SEKAI.
Nice to meet you.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-How do you know my name?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Let's talk about this in your SEKAI.
You should come visit soon. Everyone is waiting.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wh-What was that all about?
What did she mean, Miku from my SEKAI?
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, this is it!
This is the song that girl in the restaurant was singing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I can't believe I found it!
Hehehe. I wonder if that strange Miku had something to do with it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? The chorus is different than I remember.
Did she do her own arrangement?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Did she change this part, too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hm... I think the rhythm is different, too.
That girl's version sounded a lot smoother than this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know... This part sounds a little more like it, but...
One week later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, Kohane! You sure have been singing that a lot lately.
What song is it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah! U-Um... It's this one here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, let me hear!
Huh! I never pictured you as the type to listen to rap!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I guess it is a little strange...that I'd listen to this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I didn't mean it that way!
I just didn't expect it, that's all! Have you always been into this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I just started listening to it recently.
I heard someone singing in a cafe about a week ago.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In a cafe?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. It's a place called Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I looked it up, and apparently the owner used to be a pretty famous musician. Now it's a place where local music lovers get together to sing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really? I didn't realize there were places like that!
A cafe where you can listen to live music? Sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Live music always sounds so much better! I think the same thing every time I go to an idol concert. It's like...you can feel the music reverberating inside you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Reverberating?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wonder if I could feel that same sensation again if I went back and saw that girl again...)
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Am I imagining things? This place doesn't feel nearly as scary as before. Is it because it's still light out?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And when I really look, this graffiti is amazing!
This is supposed to be a kind of art, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe this place is all right after all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If I remember correctly, Weekend Garage is just around this corner.
(I could have sworn I just heard someone say Weekend Garage.)
Oh well. I've still got a little time before I'm supposed to meet up with Akito. Might as well kill some time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Found it! Weekend Garage!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for me to go back in there...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I ran out on that girl last time...
I probably didn't leave a very good impression...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No. I already made up my mind that I'd come listen to that song again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I've got to open the door!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome! Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah! U-Um... I...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! Aren't you that girl who was in here watching the other day?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I remember because it's not often we get other girls my age in here. I'm happy you decided to come back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Dad! That cute girl who came in to check us out last week is back!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Is that so? Welcome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Welcome to Weekend Garage!
bgm_area00003

Hm? Miku, where did you get off to?
You look quite pleased about something.
Ah, don't tell me you already went to meet them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Just a quick look, though.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think it'll be much longer before they come visit.
